name: Snipping
description: Shears snip a plant that grows by itself, so it stops growing. A sapling never becomes a tree, wheat stays as ripe as it is, a mushroom doesn't spread, sugar cane and cactus stay as tall as they are, and with Pumpkins a pumpkin doesn't spread. A snip costs the shears a use. A snipped plant looks as it did: shears on it again do nothing, which is how to tell. Bonemeal does nothing on a snipped sapling or wheat, and isn't used. Break a snipped plant and what you pick up is as ever, so planted again it grows. It runs where the world runs, so a server can use it with any client.
